verdict.rationale: Fireflies does not offer an OpenAPI/Swagger file — direct probes for standard OpenAPI paths returned 404 — but its GraphQL API supports schema introspection, a machine-readable equivalent for discovering the API structure programmatically. This satisfies the spirit of 'machine-readable spec' but not the literal downloadable OpenAPI artifact many AI tooling pipelines expect. Missing for 10: an actual downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec file, and any documented tooling to export the GraphQL schema as SDL/JSON for offline consumption.
